title: Figure
description: A plain <figure> gets image handling: clicking the image opens it in a lightbox (write lightbox="false" to stop that), caption sets the <figcaption> text, and captionPosition="overlay" lays the caption across the bottom of the image.

captionPosition.description: Where the caption sits: `bottom` (default) places it beneath the image; `overlay` positions it absolutely across the bottom of the image on a translucent dark bar.

zoom.description: Clicking the image opens it at full size. Bare attribute.

lightbox.description: Open the image in a lightbox on click. **On by default** — this is opt-OUT, so write `lightbox="false"` to disable it.

caption.description: Caption text. Sets the `<figcaption>` content, creating one if the figure has none.
examples: Golden Gate, seen from Battery Spencer at dusk — the lights just coming on.

width.description: Width of the whole figure, image and caption together. A bare number is pixels (`width="320"`); any CSS length works (`20rem`, `50%`). Capped at the container's width. For the image's height or shape, set `width`+`height` or `aspect-ratio` on the ``.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
